The ride record says the ride runs through mid-September; the host's page gives no indication it resumes. Check @pedalbicycles on Instagram or call PEDAL's Portage shop at (269) 324-5555.

The watch URL (ourliveswisconsin.com/article/madison-queer-bike-ride/) returns 403 to both the watcher and WebFetch; last loaded Sep 30, 2026. Check the host's Instagram @madisonqueerbikeride for current dates.

The watch URL (thursdaynightmtbr.org) has a TLS certificate mismatch (hosted on user.fm, cert covers *.user.fm not the domain) and cannot load. May 2026 TNR rides were listed on Missoula Underground (missoulaunderground.com) but the group's Nov 2025 announcement said they move to hiking and skiing for winter. Check missoulaunderground.com or the TNR Facebook group (facebook.com/groups/150671295989) for the 2026-27 season return date.

The BCP weekly calendar (phillybikeclub.org/bcpdo/ride/calendarweekly) is behind a Cloudflare JavaScript challenge and returns 403 to all automated requests; it must be opened in a browser. The BCP calendar reportedly lists about 35 rides a week, so the Sunny Sunday D Ride likely still appears there.

The Portland Gear Hub events page (portlandgearhub.org/events) loads but lists no Thursday group ride; the two current events are Cranksgiving (Nov 7) and an Oxbow winter kickoff (Nov 8), suggesting the Thursday ride is off for the season. The schedule-text-changed flag was a cosmetic change (a hiring notice added to the nav, not a schedule update). Call the shop at (207) 761-7632 or email pghinfo@ketchaoutdoors.org to confirm whether the Thursday ride resumes in spring.
